scope: Headless test checks a parameter-driven sketch prism at 10 and 20 mm, topology, volume, per-face area, and face/edge/vertex reference keys across undo, redo, and serialization.

Native test creates a part and uses scripted pointer and keyboard events through the GUI loop to create and edit a parameter-driven cube, check model values, undo/redo, save/reopen, and resolve a face. Its model-state fixture is created through the typed API.
limitations: This is not a complete R3 milestone exit audit or a BDD acceptance receipt.
The native test injects events into the application GUI loop. It is not an external OS mouse/keyboard or foreground MCPBridge test.
The native test checks a framebuffer in memory but this run did not save a screenshot.
These selected tests do not establish the full kernel and cross-platform gates.
